visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split-screen or overlay comparison. In the background, a resort scene shows a man in a white shirt floating a luxury breakfast tray in an infinity pool overlooking the ocean. In the foreground, a man in a black shirt holds a phone and looks at the screen with an exaggerated expression. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor living room. The man in the black shirt enters carrying a large silver metal washbasin filled with water. Inside the basin, a small decorative plate floats, carrying a carrot, an onion, an apple, and an orange. He walks towards a coffee table. (3) A woman in a black sheer top is sitting on a gray sofa, looking at her phone. She looks up with a confused and skeptical facial expression as the man places the basin on the table. (4) Close-up shots of the basin and the individual fruits. The man makes hand gestures, pointing at the 'floating fruit' while smiling broadly at the camera. (5) The man reaches behind him and produces an orange iPhone box. The woman looks surprised and happy, smiling and touching her face. (6) The man opens the box to reveal a yellow scouring pad (sponge) inside. The woman's expression changes to amusement and mock disappointment. (7) A second iPhone box is brought out. The man opens it to reveal another sponge. (8) Finally, a third box is presented. The man opens it, and this time a real titanium-colored smartphone is visible. The woman reacts with high excitement, covering her mouth and then hugging the man. (9) The couple poses together, holding the new phone and the original washbasin, smiling at the camera in a brightly lit modern living room setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat electronic comedy BGM begins instantly. A male voice speaks rapidly and enthusiastically, introducing a 'surprise.' (2) Faint splashing sounds are heard as the washbasin is moved. A female voice interjects with a sharp, rising intonation expressing confusion and laughter. (3) BGM continues with a steady 4/4 beat. A whimsical 'pop' sound effect occurs as text overlays appear. (4) The man's voice drops slightly in pitch but remains animated as he reveals the first box. Sound of light cardboard rustling is audible. (5) A comical 'fail' stinger or boing SFX plays when the sponge is revealed, followed by the female's mocking laughter. (6) Music swells and transitions into a warmer, celebratory tone as the real phone is revealed. The woman lets out a high-pitched exclamation of joy and several 'thank you's with a very positive valence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Prank Setup -> Multiple False Reveals -> True Surprise -> Emotional Payoff
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic lifestyle vlog created to entertain viewers through a prank-based surprise narrative. The husband parodies high-end luxury resort 'floating breakfasts' using a washbasin and raw produce before engaging in a 'fake gift' prank with an iPhone box, ultimately surprising his wife with a real, high-spec smartphone.
